frontmatter.name: stca
frontmatter.description: Use STCA to select bundled polymer screening rules, learn readable rules from uploaded measured or computed CSV data, and export complete generation prompts for the current or another LLM. Preserve original repeat-unit SMILES; verify candidates against exact frozen conditions. Triggers: STCA、聚合物筛选、规则提取、生成prompt。
frontmatter.description_zh: 选择内置聚合物规则筛选候选，从上传的数据归纳新规则，或获取完整 prompt 交给 LLM 生成并核验新结构。
frontmatter.description_en: Screen with bundled polymer rules, learn rules from uploaded data, and use complete prompts to generate and verify new structures.
frontmatter.author: Weihao Wang
examples_zh: 列出内置高热导规则，按我选择的数据集和百分比筛选候选 CSV。
从上传的实测或计算性质 CSV 自动归纳规则，并给出可直接使用的生成 prompt。
将选定规则转成完整的中文 prompt，让 LLM 生成20个新重复单元并逐条核验。
examples_en: List bundled high thermal-conductivity rules and screen my candidate CSV with my chosen dataset and tier.
Learn rules from my measured or computed property CSV and provide complete generation prompts.
Use the chosen rules to generate 20 repeat units, then verify each candidate.

entry_note: 先按 SKILL.md 选择现成规则、上传数据归纳规则或生成 prompt。现成规则和双语 prompt 位于 assets/rule_library。仅在计算时由宿主 agent 自动发现或准备后端，用户以自然语言调用，无需操作终端。安装入口见 references/workbuddy.md。
